name: fusionify-audio-intelligence
description: Analyze local music, review beat timing and render music-driven videos from Claude Desktop. Requires uv and FFmpeg.

media_root.title: Music and video folder
media_root.description: Select an existing folder containing the tracks and footage you want Claude to use.

uv_command.title: uv executable
uv_command.description: Leave as uv if it is on PATH, or enter the absolute path to uv or uv.exe.

ffmpeg_dir.title: FFmpeg bin folder (optional)
ffmpeg_dir.description: Select the folder containing ffmpeg and ffprobe if Claude Desktop cannot find them on PATH.
